content.text: How can I enhance the package scanner to log vulnerabilities more effectively?
I need to set up Jest for testing the new logger functionality.
What should be the structure of the vulnerability data I'm logging?
I encountered an error when running tests: 'ReferenceError: logVulnerability is not defined'.

This error may occur if the import statement for 'logVulnerability' is missing. Ensure you have the following at the top of 'tests/scanner.test.js':
```javascript
const { logVulnerability } = require('../src/utils/logger');
``` Also, double-check the path for any typos.
How can I ensure that the package scanner is performance-optimized?
